subject: Agriculture
title: Pesticides and the Green Revolution
description: A short lesson to help you apply Pesticides and the Green Revolution.

hook.text: Dense monocultures of high-yield crops are pest magnets. The Green Revolution needed chemical protection.

buildup.text: Pesticide use in India increased 200-fold between 1960 and 2000, paralleling Green Revolution adoption.

discovery.text: Chemicals controlled insects, fungi, and weeds that thrived in the new uniform, fertilized fields.

twist.text: Pests evolved resistance. Farmers applied more chemicals, creating a treadmill of escalating inputs.

climax.text: Health effects on farm workers—poisoning, cancer risks—became a growing but underreported crisis.

punchline.text: The revolution packed a punch—but the chemicals punched back.

quiz.question: How much did pesticide use increase in India during the Green Revolution era?
